source_text: I forgot, I also need her pin to open the files.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I forgot, I also need her pin to open the files.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I forgot, I also need her pin to open the files."

translation: Zapomniałem, potrzebuję też jej PIN-u, żeby otworzyć pliki.

source_text: Most people around here use their house number…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Most people around here use their house number…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Most people around here use their house number…"

translation: Większość ludzi używa numeru domu…

source_text: Melissa lives in the condos near the Channel 4 building…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Melissa lives in the condos near the Channel 4 building…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Melissa lives in the condos near the Channel 4 building…"

translation: Melissa mieszka w apartamentowcu niedaleko budynku Channel 4…

source_text: What is her house number?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What is her house number?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What is her house number? "

translation: Jaki ma numer domu?

source_text: Computer hacking is a serious crime.

structure.raw_value: NPC.Computer hacking is a serious crime.
structure.script_literal: "NPC.Computer hacking is a serious crime."

translation: Włamywanie się do komputerów to poważne przestępstwo.

source_text: David. Where are you heading?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.David. Where are you heading?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.David. Where are you heading?"

translation: David. Dokąd idziesz?

source_text: Why do you care?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.Why do you care?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.Why do you care?"

translation: A co cię to obchodzi?

source_text: No reason. I just want to know what you’re up to. You’ve got some interesting cases.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.No reason. I just want to know what you’re up to. You’ve got some interesting cases.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.No reason. I just want to know what you’re up to. You’ve got some interesting cases."

translation: Bez powodu. Chcę tylko wiedzieć, co porabiasz. Masz ciekawe sprawy.

source_text: I’m going to the interrogation room.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.I’m going to the interrogation room.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.I’m going to the interrogation room."

translation: Idę do pokoju przesłuchań.

source_text: Talking to someone interesting?

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Talking to someone interesting?
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Talking to someone interesting?"

translation: Przesłuchujesz kogoś ciekawego?

source_text: It’s Guild stuff. That’s what the informants are telling me.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx.It’s Guild stuff. That’s what the informants are telling me.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx.It’s Guild stuff. That’s what the informants are telling me."

translation: Chodzi o Gildię. Tak mówią informatorzy.

source_text: Maybe I can tag along.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Maybe I can tag along.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Maybe I can tag along."

translation: Może pójdę z tobą.

source_text: It wouldn’t hurt to have a second person in there. Maybe we give it the old good cop, bad cop routine.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.It wouldn’t hurt to have a second person in there. Maybe we give it the old good cop, bad cop routine.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.It wouldn’t hurt to have a second person in there. Maybe we give it the old good cop, bad cop routine."

translation: Nie zaszkodzi mieć tam drugą osobę. Możemy zagrać w dobrego i złego glinę.

source_text: I’m not interested in playing around.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.I’m not interested in playing around.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.I’m not interested in playing around."

translation: Nie mam ochoty na takie zabawy.

source_text: If I can just get him to leave the room, I may be able to sneak in there to talk to her.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.If I can just get him to leave the room, I may be able to sneak in there to talk to her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.If I can just get him to leave the room, I may be able to sneak in there to talk to her."

translation: Jeśli tylko wyciągnę go z pokoju, może uda mi się zakraść i z nią porozmawiać.

source_text: So you’ve graced us with your presence again.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.So you’ve graced us with your presence again.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.So you’ve graced us with your presence again."

translation: Czyli znów zaszczyciłeś nas swoją obecnością.

source_text: Ha. At least I get plenty of exercise.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Ha. At least I get plenty of exercise.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Ha. At least I get plenty of exercise."

translation: Ha. Przynajmniej mam sporo ruchu.

source_text: So why was Kimura asking about me?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So why was Kimura asking about me?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.So why was Kimura asking about me?"

translation: Czemu Kimura o mnie pytała?

source_text: Not too sure. When she showed up, she asked who was working the Guild case.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Not too sure. When she showed up, she asked who was working the Guild case.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Not too sure. When she showed up, she asked who was working the Guild case."

translation: Nie jestem pewien. Kiedy przyszła, zapytała, kto prowadzi sprawę Gildii.

source_text: When she found out it was me, she switched to asking where Melissa was.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.When she found out it was me, she switched to asking where Melissa was.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.When she found out it was me, she switched to asking where Melissa was."

translation: Gdy dowiedziała się, że to ja, zaczęła pytać, gdzie jest Melissa.

source_text: I told her Melissa wasn’t back yet after you and her went out to investigate something.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.I told her Melissa wasn’t back yet after you and her went out to investigate something.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.I told her Melissa wasn’t back yet after you and her went out to investigate something."

translation: Powiedziałem, że Melissa jeszcze nie wróciła po waszym wspólnym śledztwie.

source_text: Then the commissioner asked if you were around instead.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx.Then the commissioner asked if you were around instead.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx.Then the commissioner asked if you were around instead."

translation: Potem pani komisarz zapytała, czy ty jesteś na miejscu.

source_text: About the Guild case? Why would she want me for that?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.About the Guild case? Why would she want me for that?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.About the Guild case? Why would she want me for that?"

translation: W sprawie Gildii? Po co miałaby mnie do tego potrzebować?

source_text: Beats me. But hey, you’re a detective. I’m sure you can figure it out if you try.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.Beats me. But hey, you’re a detective. I’m sure you can figure it out if you try.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.Beats me. But hey, you’re a detective. I’m sure you can figure it out if you try."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia. Ale jesteś detektywem. Na pewno to rozgryziesz.

source_text: Thanks, David.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Thanks, David.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Thanks, David."

translation: Dzięki, David.

source_text: Sure thing. I’ll let you know if any other business comes your way.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Sure thing. I’ll let you know if any other business comes your way.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Sure thing. I’ll let you know if any other business comes your way."

translation: Nie ma sprawy. Dam ci znać, jeśli pojawi się coś jeszcze.

source_text: Wow, thanks.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Wow, thanks.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Wow, thanks."

translation: Wow, dzięki.

source_text: I’m being sarcastic. Maybe you should hire a secretary.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.I’m being sarcastic. Maybe you should hire a secretary.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.I’m being sarcastic. Maybe you should hire a secretary."

translation: To był sarkazm. Może powinieneś zatrudnić sekretarkę.

source_text: I wonder what Andrea wants me for.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I wonder what Andrea wants me for.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I wonder what Andrea wants me for."

translation: Ciekawe, po co Andrea mnie potrzebuje.

source_text: Maybe she sees there’s more to me. This could be my big chance to show what I’m capable of!

structure.raw_value: McHaAg.Maybe she sees there’s more to me. This could be my big chance to show what I’m capable of!
structure.script_literal: "McHaAg.Maybe she sees there’s more to me. This could be my big chance to show what I’m capable of!"

translation: Może dostrzegła, że stać mnie na więcej. To wielka szansa, żeby pokazać, co potrafię!

source_text: But if I don’t talk to her before the day is over, I might miss the opportunity.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.But if I don’t talk to her before the day is over, I might miss the opportunity.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.But if I don’t talk to her before the day is over, I might miss the opportunity."

translation: Jeśli nie porozmawiam z nią przed końcem dnia, mogę stracić tę szansę.

source_text: First, I’ll have to find her. She’s probably in the executive area upstairs.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.First, I’ll have to find her. She’s probably in the executive area upstairs.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.First, I’ll have to find her. She’s probably in the executive area upstairs."

translation: Najpierw muszę ją znaleźć. Pewnie jest na górze, w części dla kierownictwa.

source_text: Hmm. Access to that area is restricted. I wonder how I can get in.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Hmm. Access to that area is restricted. I wonder how I can get in.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Hmm. Access to that area is restricted. I wonder how I can get in."

translation: Hmm. Dostęp do tej części jest ograniczony. Ciekawe, jak się tam dostać.

source_text: I don’t know what’s up with Melissa, but I’m not sticking around while she’s in a bad mood.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.I don’t know what’s up with Melissa, but I’m not sticking around while she’s in a bad mood.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.I don’t know what’s up with Melissa, but I’m not sticking around while she’s in a bad mood."

translation: Nie wiem, co jest z Melissą, ale nie będę tu siedzieć, kiedy jest w złym humorze.

source_text: Late lunch… I’m going to Dick’s.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx.Late lunch… I’m going to Dick’s.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx.Late lunch… I’m going to Dick’s."

translation: Późny lunch… Idę do Dick’s.

source_text: Make it quick, 1Hero. I have a lot of work to do today.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Make it quick, 1Hero. I have a lot of work to do today.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Make it quick, 1Hero. I have a lot of work to do today."

translation: Mów szybko, 1Hero. Mam dziś mnóstwo pracy.

source_text: Madalyn is back in town, and I need to warn Lillian…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Madalyn is back in town, and I need to warn Lillian…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Madalyn is back in town, and I need to warn Lillian…"

translation: Madalyn wróciła do miasta. Muszę ostrzec Lillian…

source_text: What!? Are you sure? How do you know?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.What!? Are you sure? How do you know?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.What!? Are you sure? How do you know?"

translation: Co!? Na pewno? Skąd wiesz?

source_text: Well… It’s complicated, and I’ve got to run.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Well… It’s complicated, and I’ve got to run.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Well… It’s complicated, and I’ve got to run."

translation: Cóż… To skomplikowane, a ja muszę już iść.

source_text: You’re not going to the mansion. You need to focus on your own cases.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.You’re not going to the mansion. You need to focus on your own cases.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.You’re not going to the mansion. You need to focus on your own cases."

translation: Nie jedziesz do rezydencji. Masz skupić się na własnych sprawach.

source_text: No, it’s not that. I have a meeting with the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.No, it’s not that. I have a meeting with the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.No, it’s not that. I have a meeting with the commissioner."

translation: Nie o to chodzi. Mam spotkanie z panią komisarz.

source_text: What? You scheduled a meeting with Kimura without telling me!?

structure.raw_value: MeShOpNo1.What? You scheduled a meeting with Kimura without telling me!?
structure.script_literal: "MeShOpNo1.What? You scheduled a meeting with Kimura without telling me!?"

translation: Co? Umówiłeś się z Kimurą i nic mi nie powiedziałeś!?

source_text: What the hell is going on? Why’s he in so early?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.What the hell is going on? Why’s he in so early?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.What the hell is going on? Why’s he in so early?"

translation: Co tu się, do cholery, dzieje? Czemu przyszedł tak wcześnie?

source_text: I’m going to be on the news.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.I’m going to be on the news.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.I’m going to be on the news."

translation: Wystąpię w wiadomościach.

source_text: What are you talking about? The commissioner asked you to be on the news?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.What are you talking about? The commissioner asked you to be on the news?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.What are you talking about? The commissioner asked you to be on the news?"

translation: O czym ty mówisz? Pani komisarz poprosiła cię o występ w wiadomościach?

source_text: I thought she might have told you.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I thought she might have told you.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I thought she might have told you."

translation: Myślałem, że ci powiedziała.

source_text: Are you going over my head again, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Are you going over my head again, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Are you going over my head again, 1Hero?"

translation: Znowu działasz za moimi plecami, 1Hero?

source_text: She wants me to be on the Guild case.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She wants me to be on the Guild case.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She wants me to be on the Guild case."

translation: Chce, żebym zajął się sprawą Gildii.

source_text: Wait. I’m pretty sure I’m the only one in the office on that case right now.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.Wait. I’m pretty sure I’m the only one in the office on that case right now.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.Wait. I’m pretty sure I’m the only one in the office on that case right now."

translation: Chwileczkę. Jestem chyba jedyną osobą w biurze, która teraz prowadzi tę sprawę.

source_text: Not anymore.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Not anymore.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Not anymore."

translation: Już nie.

source_text: What did you do, 1Hero? What did you say to her?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.What did you do, 1Hero? What did you say to her?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.What did you do, 1Hero? What did you say to her?"

translation: Co zrobiłeś, 1Hero? Co jej powiedziałeś?

source_text: Nothing… I mean… We just had dinner.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Nothing… I mean… We just had dinner.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Nothing… I mean… We just had dinner."

translation: Nic… To znaczy… Po prostu zjedliśmy razem kolację.

source_text: You ate dinner with Kimura?

structure.raw_value: DaShOpNo1^.You ate dinner with Kimura?
structure.script_literal: "DaShOpNo1^.You ate dinner with Kimura?"

translation: Jadłeś kolację z Kimurą?

source_text: You’re getting distracted. Madalyn Rose is here in North Santiva! I saw her in the forest.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You’re getting distracted. Madalyn Rose is here in North Santiva! I saw her in the forest.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You’re getting distracted. Madalyn Rose is here in North Santiva! I saw her in the forest."

translation: Rozpraszasz się. Madalyn Rose jest w North Santiva! Widziałem ją w lesie.

source_text: The old woman from Saint Dame?

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe^.The old woman from Saint Dame?
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe^.The old woman from Saint Dame?"

translation: Tę staruszkę z Saint Dame?

source_text: Mistakes from you reflect poorly on me.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOP.Mistakes from you reflect poorly on me.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOP.Mistakes from you reflect poorly on me."

translation: Twoje błędy źle świadczą o mnie.

source_text: Jesus, I got it.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Jesus, I got it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Jesus, I got it."

translation: Jezu, zrozumiałem.

source_text: But what about Lillian and Erica? They could be in danger at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.But what about Lillian and Erica? They could be in danger at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.But what about Lillian and Erica? They could be in danger at the mansion."

translation: A co z Lillian i Ericą? Mogą być w niebezpieczeństwie w rezydencji.

source_text: David, go to the Wilkes’ property, and bring an officer.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.David, go to the Wilkes’ property, and bring an officer.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.David, go to the Wilkes’ property, and bring an officer."

translation: David, jedź do posiadłości Wilkesów i zabierz ze sobą funkcjonariusza.

source_text: But, Miss Bhatt, I have work to do today.

structure.raw_value: DaShEx^.But, Miss Bhatt, I have work to do today.
structure.script_literal: "DaShEx^.But, Miss Bhatt, I have work to do today."

translation: Ale, panno Bhatt, mam dziś pracę.

source_text: Apparently, 1Hero is preoccupied.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Apparently, 1Hero is preoccupied.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Apparently, 1Hero is preoccupied."

translation: Najwyraźniej 1Hero jest zajęty.

source_text: Stop being lazy, David. I’ll stop by after my interview.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Stop being lazy, David. I’ll stop by after my interview.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Stop being lazy, David. I’ll stop by after my interview."

translation: Przestań się obijać, David. Wpadnę po wywiadzie.

source_text: I don’t want to babysit a rich kid. I should be doing that interview.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.I don’t want to babysit a rich kid. I should be doing that interview.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.I don’t want to babysit a rich kid. I should be doing that interview."

translation: Nie chcę niańczyć bogatego dzieciaka. To ja powinienem udzielić tego wywiadu.

source_text: You’re too ugly.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You’re too ugly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You’re too ugly."

translation: Jesteś za brzydki.

source_text: What did you say!?

structure.raw_value: DaMaAgNo1^.What did you say!?
structure.script_literal: "DaMaAgNo1^.What did you say!?"

translation: Coś ty powiedziała!?

source_text: Stop it! Leave, 1Hero. I’ll handle this.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Stop it! Leave, 1Hero. I’ll handle this.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.Stop it! Leave, 1Hero. I’ll handle this."

translation: Przestańcie! Idź, 1Hero. Ja się tym zajmę.

source_text: God dammit.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe^.God dammit.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe^.God dammit."

translation: Cholera jasna.

source_text: I better not linger. Andrea is probably waiting for me upstairs.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I better not linger. Andrea is probably waiting for me upstairs.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I better not linger. Andrea is probably waiting for me upstairs."

translation: Lepiej nie zwlekać. Andrea pewnie czeka na mnie na górze.

source_text: What the hell am I going to do now?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What the hell am I going to do now?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What the hell am I going to do now?"

translation: Co ja teraz, do cholery, zrobię?

source_text: Get your ass in my office! Now!

structure.raw_value: MeMaOpNo1.Get your ass in my office! Now!
structure.script_literal: "MeMaOpNo1.Get your ass in my office! Now!"

translation: Ruszyć tyłek do mojego biura! Natychmiast!

source_text: Coming to work on time?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Coming to work on time?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Coming to work on time?"

translation: Przyszedłeś do pracy na czas?

source_text: Just so you know, I was out late last night working on that safe.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Just so you know, I was out late last night working on that safe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Just so you know, I was out late last night working on that safe."

translation: Żebyś wiedziała, do późna w nocy pracowałem nad tym sejfem.

source_text: I told you, let an expert break it open.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.I told you, let an expert break it open.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.I told you, let an expert break it open."

translation: Mówiłam, żebyś pozwolił otworzyć go ekspertowi.

source_text: I opened it.

structure.raw_value: McFLEx.I opened it.
structure.script_literal: "McFLEx.I opened it."

translation: Otworzyłem go.

source_text: What? How?

structure.raw_value: MeShOp.What? How?
structure.script_literal: "MeShOp.What? How?"

translation: Co? Jak?

source_text: I found the code.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I found the code.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I found the code."

translation: Znalazłem kod.

source_text: Did you find the medication?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Did you find the medication?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Did you find the medication?"

translation: Znalazłeś leki?

source_text: Yeah, I did.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Yeah, I did.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Yeah, I did."

translation: Tak.

source_text: Give it to me. We need to get it analyzed.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Give it to me. We need to get it analyzed.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Give it to me. We need to get it analyzed."

translation: Daj mi je. Musimy je przebadać.

source_text: Don’t act so impressed.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t act so impressed.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t act so impressed."

translation: Nie udawaj takiego wrażenia.

source_text: So, you’re trying to impress me?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.So, you’re trying to impress me?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.So, you’re trying to impress me?"

translation: Czyli próbujesz mi zaimponować?

source_text: Is it possible?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Is it possible?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Is it possible?"

translation: Mam szansę?

source_text: Just give me the pills.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Just give me the pills.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Just give me the pills."

translation: Po prostu daj mi te tabletki.

source_text: I was supposed to meet with the commissioner, but she didn’t show up this morning.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.I was supposed to meet with the commissioner, but she didn’t show up this morning.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.I was supposed to meet with the commissioner, but she didn’t show up this morning."

translation: Miałam dziś rano spotkać się z panią komisarz, ale się nie pojawiła.

source_text: I’ll take this bottle to the lab to get analyzed and inform the commissioner that a police presence may also be needed at Eve Cathedral.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.I’ll take this bottle to the lab to get analyzed and inform the commissioner that a police presence may also be needed at Eve Cathedral.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.I’ll take this bottle to the lab to get analyzed and inform the commissioner that a police presence may also be needed at Eve Cathedral."

translation: Zaniosę tę butelkę do laboratorium na badania i powiadomię panią komisarz, że w Katedrze Ewy może być potrzebna policja.

source_text: I can find her.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I can find her.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I can find her."

translation: Mogę ją znaleźć.

source_text: No. Leave it to me.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.No. Leave it to me.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.No. Leave it to me."

translation: Nie. Zostaw to mnie.

source_text: Keep an eye on the church.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Keep an eye on the church.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Keep an eye on the church."

translation: Miej oko na kościół.

source_text: Fine. I’ll make sure everyone is safe.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Fine. I’ll make sure everyone is safe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Fine. I’ll make sure everyone is safe."

translation: Dobrze. Dopilnuję, żeby wszyscy byli bezpieczni.

source_text: What the hell are you working on?

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.What the hell are you working on?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.What the hell are you working on?"

translation: Nad czym ty, do cholery, pracujesz?

source_text: It’s not the Guild case, David.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It’s not the Guild case, David.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It’s not the Guild case, David."

translation: To nie sprawa Gildii, David.

source_text: You have a new case?

structure.raw_value: DaShOp.You have a new case?
structure.script_literal: "DaShOp.You have a new case?"

translation: Masz nową sprawę?

source_text: It’s not our case… It’s an old closed case regarding a dead priest.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s not our case… It’s an old closed case regarding a dead priest.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s not our case… It’s an old closed case regarding a dead priest."

translation: To nie nasza sprawa… Chodzi o starą, zamkniętą sprawę martwego księdza.

source_text: But it may be tied to Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But it may be tied to Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But it may be tied to Madalyn."

translation: Ale może mieć związek z Madalyn.

source_text: Madalyn is the killer. I just know it.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Madalyn is the killer. I just know it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Madalyn is the killer. I just know it."

translation: Madalyn jest morderczynią. Po prostu to wiem.

source_text: Are you keeping information from me?

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.Are you keeping information from me?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.Are you keeping information from me?"

translation: Coś przede mną ukrywasz?

source_text: It’s a hunch. But somehow the Guild, Madalyn, and the dead priest are tied together.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.It’s a hunch. But somehow the Guild, Madalyn, and the dead priest are tied together.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.It’s a hunch. But somehow the Guild, Madalyn, and the dead priest are tied together."

translation: To przeczucie. Ale Gildia, Madalyn i martwy ksiądz są jakoś ze sobą powiązani.

source_text: Okay, I see. Good luck, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DaFlOp.Okay, I see. Good luck, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DaFlOp.Okay, I see. Good luck, 1Hero."

translation: Rozumiem. Powodzenia, 1Hero.

source_text: You don’t believe me?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You don’t believe me?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You don’t believe me?"

translation: Nie wierzysz mi?

source_text: Sometimes life is boring, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Sometimes life is boring, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Sometimes life is boring, 1Hero."

translation: Czasem życie jest nudne, 1Hero.

source_text: And sometimes conspiracies are true.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.And sometimes conspiracies are true.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.And sometimes conspiracies are true."

translation: A czasem teorie spiskowe okazują się prawdą.

source_text: You’re just in time.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.You’re just in time.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.You’re just in time."

translation: W samą porę.

source_text: Don’t tell me that you told Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t tell me that you told Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t tell me that you told Andrea."

translation: Nie mów, że powiedziałeś Andrei.

source_text: We’re not keeping secrets from the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.We’re not keeping secrets from the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.We’re not keeping secrets from the commissioner."

translation: Nie będziemy niczego ukrywać przed panią komisarz.

source_text: Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Miss Kimura."

translation: Pani Kimura.

source_text: You’ve brought this on yourself, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.You’ve brought this on yourself, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.You’ve brought this on yourself, 1Hero."

translation: Sam się o to prosiłeś, 1Hero.

source_text: You really fucked up this time, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.You really fucked up this time, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.You really fucked up this time, 1Hero."

translation: Tym razem naprawdę spieprzyłeś sprawę, 1Hero.

source_text: You don’t need to rub it in… Andrea fired me.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You don’t need to rub it in… Andrea fired me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You don’t need to rub it in… Andrea fired me."

translation: Nie musisz mi tego wypominać… Andrea mnie zwolniła.

source_text: To be honest, I half expected she’d let you off the hook.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.To be honest, I half expected she’d let you off the hook.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.To be honest, I half expected she’d let you off the hook."

translation: Szczerze mówiąc, spodziewałem się, że ci odpuści.

source_text: Thanks to you, I have to go to Channel 4 today and do an interview.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Thanks to you, I have to go to Channel 4 today and do an interview.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Thanks to you, I have to go to Channel 4 today and do an interview."

translation: Przez ciebie muszę dziś iść do Channel 4 i udzielić wywiadu.

source_text: It was your case to begin with. Shouldn’t you be happy?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.It was your case to begin with. Shouldn’t you be happy?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.It was your case to begin with. Shouldn’t you be happy?"

translation: Od początku to była twoja sprawa. Nie powinieneś się cieszyć?

source_text: Not if I have to do more work.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.Not if I have to do more work.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.Not if I have to do more work."

translation: Nie, jeśli oznacza to więcej pracy.

source_text: Clean out my desk… I’m out of here.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Clean out my desk… I’m out of here.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Clean out my desk… I’m out of here."

translation: Opróżnij moje biurko… Zwijam się stąd.

source_text: So you’re staying away from the mansion?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.So you’re staying away from the mansion?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.So you’re staying away from the mansion?"

translation: Czyli trzymasz się z dala od rezydencji?

source_text: You’re not my boss anymore.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You’re not my boss anymore.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You’re not my boss anymore."

translation: Nie jesteś już moją szefową.

source_text: Come on, detective. You’ve got to leave.

structure.raw_value: OaAnOp.Come on, detective. You’ve got to leave.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnOp.Come on, detective. You’ve got to leave."

translation: Chodź, detektywie. Musisz już iść.

source_text: Fine. Good riddance.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Fine. Good riddance.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Fine. Good riddance."

translation: Dobra. I krzyżyk na drogę.

source_text: Fuck! What a thorn in my side!

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Fuck! What a thorn in my side!
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Fuck! What a thorn in my side!"

translation: Kurwa! Ależ mi działa na nerwy!

source_text: Pissing off the commissioner now, too?

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.Pissing off the commissioner now, too?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.Pissing off the commissioner now, too?"

translation: Teraz jeszcze wkurzyłeś panią komisarz?

source_text: People would be a lot less pissed if they would trust me.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.People would be a lot less pissed if they would trust me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.People would be a lot less pissed if they would trust me."

translation: Ludzie byliby znacznie mniej wkurzeni, gdyby mi ufali.

source_text: Hey! I’m the only one of us that actually gets anything done!

structure.raw_value: McMaOpNo1.Hey! I’m the only one of us that actually gets anything done!
structure.script_literal: "McMaOpNo1.Hey! I’m the only one of us that actually gets anything done!"

translation: Hej! Tylko ja z nas naprawdę coś robię!

source_text: Shit. I better cool off.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Shit. I better cool off.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Shit. I better cool off."

translation: Cholera. Lepiej ochłonę.

source_text: Dammit, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Dammit, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Dammit, 1Hero."

translation: Cholera, 1Hero.

source_text: What!? What’s going on?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What!? What’s going on?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What!? What’s going on?"

translation: Co!? Co się dzieje?

source_text: Meet me in my office. Now.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Meet me in my office. Now.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Meet me in my office. Now."

translation: Natychmiast przyjdź do mojego gabinetu.

source_text: What’s wrong with everyone today?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What’s wrong with everyone today?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What’s wrong with everyone today?"

translation: Co się dziś dzieje z tymi wszystkimi ludźmi?

source_text: You fucked up, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.You fucked up, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.You fucked up, 1Hero."

translation: Spieprzyłeś sprawę, 1Hero.

source_text: Your little sex tape.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.Your little sex tape.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.Your little sex tape."

translation: Twoje małe nagranie erotyczne.

source_text: You’re shooting porno videos now?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.You’re shooting porno videos now?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.You’re shooting porno videos now?"

translation: Kręcisz teraz filmy porno?

source_text: Fuck! I need to talk to Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Fuck! I need to talk to Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Fuck! I need to talk to Andrea."

translation: Kurwa! Muszę porozmawiać z Andreą.

source_text: Miss me?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Miss me?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Miss me?"

translation: Tęskniłaś?

source_text: How long does she need to be here?

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.How long does she need to be here?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.How long does she need to be here?"

translation: Jak długo ona ma tu zostać?

source_text: Just keep her safe until I come back.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Just keep her safe until I come back.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Just keep her safe until I come back."

translation: Po prostu pilnuj, żeby była bezpieczna, aż wrócę.

source_text: I’m not staying here past my shift.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.I’m not staying here past my shift.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.I’m not staying here past my shift."

translation: Nie zostanę tu po zakończeniu zmiany.

source_text: What? What happened?

structure.raw_value: DaBaOp.What? What happened?
structure.script_literal: "DaBaOp.What? What happened?"

translation: Co? Co się stało?

source_text: You tell me. Weren’t you waiting outside the changing room?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You tell me. Weren’t you waiting outside the changing room?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You tell me. Weren’t you waiting outside the changing room?"

translation: Ty mi powiedz. Nie czekałeś pod przebieralnią?

source_text: I had work to do, and you looked like you had it under control.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx.I had work to do, and you looked like you had it under control.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx.I had work to do, and you looked like you had it under control."

translation: Miałem pracę, a ty wyglądałaś, jakbyś panowała nad sytuacją.

source_text: What’s the attitude for?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.What’s the attitude for?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.What’s the attitude for?"

translation: Czemu jesteś taka naburmuszona?

source_text: Don’t worry, Judy. This will all be over soon.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Don’t worry, Judy. This will all be over soon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Don’t worry, Judy. This will all be over soon."

translation: Nie martw się, Judy. To wkrótce się skończy.

source_text: David… This is Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.David… This is Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.David… This is Judy."

translation: David… To Judy.

source_text: Where’s Bhatt?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.Where’s Bhatt?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.Where’s Bhatt?"

translation: Gdzie jest Bhatt?

source_text: Nevermind that…

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Nevermind that…
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Nevermind that…"

translation: Nieważne…

source_text: I want you to keep an eye on her. Can you do that?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I want you to keep an eye on her. Can you do that?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I want you to keep an eye on her. Can you do that?"

translation: Chcę, żebyś miał ją na oku. Dasz radę?

source_text: Hello, David.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp^.Hello, David.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp^.Hello, David."

translation: Witaj, Davidzie.

source_text: What’s her deal?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.What’s her deal?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.What’s her deal?"

translation: O co z nią chodzi?

source_text: I’m…

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl^.I’m…
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl^.I’m…"

translation: Ja…

source_text: She’s in a bit of trouble and needs to be in a safe place.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s in a bit of trouble and needs to be in a safe place.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s in a bit of trouble and needs to be in a safe place."

translation: Ma pewne kłopoty i musi zostać w bezpiecznym miejscu.

source_text: This isn’t how witness protection works.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.This isn’t how witness protection works.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.This isn’t how witness protection works."

translation: Tak nie działa program ochrony świadków.

source_text: You never leave the office… Just stay here with her.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You never leave the office… Just stay here with her.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You never leave the office… Just stay here with her."

translation: I tak nigdy nie wychodzisz z biura… Po prostu zostań tu z nią.

source_text: I’m sorry to be a bother.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl^.I’m sorry to be a bother.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl^.I’m sorry to be a bother."

translation: Przepraszam, że sprawiam kłopot.

source_text: David is grumpy. But he’ll live.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.David is grumpy. But he’ll live.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.David is grumpy. But he’ll live."

translation: David jest zrzędliwy, ale przeżyje.

source_text: Hello, Judy.

structure.raw_value: DaBaOp.Hello, Judy.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaOp.Hello, Judy."

translation: Witaj, Judy.

source_text: Your police station is very nice.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp^.Your police station is very nice.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp^.Your police station is very nice."

translation: Macie bardzo ładny komisariat.

source_text: I try my best to keep it clean.

structure.raw_value: DaFlDe.I try my best to keep it clean.
structure.script_literal: "DaFlDe.I try my best to keep it clean."

translation: Staram się utrzymywać tu porządek.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.This place is crawling with cops, Judy. You’ll be safe here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.This place is crawling with cops, Judy. You’ll be safe here."

translation: Judy, roi się tu od gliniarzy. Będziesz bezpieczna.

source_text: Please don’t be gone long.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl^.Please don’t be gone long.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl^.Please don’t be gone long. "

translation: Nie znikaj na długo, proszę.

source_text: I’ll be back before you know it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ll be back before you know it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ll be back before you know it."

translation: Wrócę, nim się obejrzysz.

translation: Proszę usiąść, panno Judy. I nie dotykać komputerów.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp^.I am very good at being quiet.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp^.I am very good at being quiet."

translation: Bardzo dobrze umiem siedzieć cicho.

source_text: The best news I’ve heard in the last few minutes.

structure.raw_value: DaFlDe.The best news I’ve heard in the last few minutes.
structure.script_literal: "DaFlDe.The best news I’ve heard in the last few minutes."

translation: Najlepsza wiadomość, jaką usłyszałem w ciągu ostatnich kilku minut.

source_text: Keep her safe, David. Bhatt’s orders.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Keep her safe, David. Bhatt’s orders.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Keep her safe, David. Bhatt’s orders."

translation: Dopilnuj jej bezpieczeństwa, David. Rozkaz panny Bhatt.

source_text: Back to work already?

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.Back to work already?
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.Back to work already?"

translation: Już wróciłeś do pracy?

source_text: What crawled up your ass?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.What crawled up your ass?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.What crawled up your ass?"

translation: Co cię ugryzło?

source_text: This damned copier takes forever.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.This damned copier takes forever.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.This damned copier takes forever."

translation: Ta przeklęta kserokopiarka działa wieczność.
